scenes.headline: ANDROID APPS ON WINDOWS
scenes.depicts: Run Android apps in their own Windows windows. This is ApkStart.

scenes.headline: SET UP, THEN INSTALL
scenes.depicts: Set up its Android runtime once, then associate APK files so a double click installs them.

scenes.headline: FROM APK TO APP
scenes.depicts: ApkStart creates a desktop shortcut. Open it to launch the app in a resizable window.

scenes.headline: WHAT RUNS IT
scenes.depicts: Behind the scenes, it uses Android tools and a virtual machine, not native Windows code.

scenes.headline: CHECK BEFORE YOU INSTALL
scenes.depicts: The first setup downloads runtime components. ARM only apps may need a compatible translation layer. Only install APKs you trust.

scenes.headline: YOUR CALL
scenes.depicts: Want the repo? Comment A P K and follow Hypeless for more tools, minus the hype.
